symbols.name: logical bit volume
symbols.meaning: The number of logical bits in the array.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the logical bit volume of the array, $p$ the number of fractional bits of the grid of multiples of $2^{-p}$, and $d$ an upper bound on the number of chunks.

symbols.name: fractional bits
symbols.meaning: The number of fractional bits of the coefficient grid.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the logical bit volume of the array, $p$ the number of fractional bits of the grid of multiples of $2^{-p}$, and $d$ an upper bound on the number of chunks.

symbols.name: chunk bound
symbols.meaning: An upper bound on the number of address chunks.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the logical bit volume of the array, $p$ the number of fractional bits of the grid of multiples of $2^{-p}$, and $d$ an upper bound on the number of chunks.

symbols.name: selected chunks
symbols.meaning: The number of address chunks in which the layer selects a bit.
symbols.quote: Here $D$ is the number of selected chunks and $K$ the chunk width in bits.

symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The number of address bits in each chunk.
symbols.quote: Here $D$ is the number of selected chunks and $K$ the chunk width in bits.

symbols.name: chunk exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent $c>0$ in the chunk width $K=\lfloor d^c\rfloor$.
symbols.quote: The layer applies $H_0(u,v)=((u+v)/2,(u-v)/2)$ to each coefficient, at one selected bit in each of $D\le d$ chunks of $K=\lfloor d^c\rfloor$ bits, with $c>0$ fixed.

symbols.name: normalized butterfly
symbols.meaning: The butterfly map $H_0(u,v)=((u+v)/2,(u-v)/2)$, applied to each coefficient.
symbols.quote: The layer applies $H_0(u,v)=((u+v)/2,(u-v)/2)$ to each coefficient, at one selected bit in each of $D\le d$ chunks of $K=\lfloor d^c\rfloor$ bits, with $c>0$ fixed.

symbols.name: bit flip
symbols.meaning: The bit-flip matrix.
symbols.quote: Write $X=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}$ for the bit flip and $C=\frac{1+i}{2}I+\frac{1-i}{2}X$.

symbols.name: two-point kernel
symbols.meaning: The complex kernel $C=\frac{1+i}{2}I+\frac{1-i}{2}X$.
symbols.quote: Write $X=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}$ for the bit flip and $C=\frac{1+i}{2}I+\frac{1-i}{2}X$.

symbols.name: phase operator
symbols.meaning: The diagonal operator that multiplies each address's value by $i$ to the power of its number of selected 1-bits.
symbols.quote: where $\mathcal S_D$ multiplies each address's value by $i$ to the power of its number of selected 1-bits.

symbols.name: group axes
symbols.meaning: The number of selected axes in a group.
symbols.quote: Here $e$ counts the axes in a group, $m$ the slots, and $s$ the child calls per node.

symbols.name: slot count
symbols.meaning: The number of slots into which a group is split.
symbols.quote: Here $e$ counts the axes in a group, $m$ the slots, and $s$ the child calls per node.

symbols.name: child calls
symbols.meaning: The number of child calls at each node.
symbols.quote: Here $e$ counts the axes in a group, $m$ the slots, and $s$ the child calls per node.

symbols.name: wire roles
symbols.meaning: The number of wire roles among which rows are split.
symbols.quote: Here $W$ is the number of wire roles.

symbols.name: time per unit volume
symbols.meaning: $F(e)$ is the time per unit volume for a group of $e$ axes.
symbols.quote: Let $F(e)$ be the time per unit volume for $e$ axes.

symbols.name: row exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent in $(0,1)$ bounding the node's row work.
symbols.quote: The $s$ children cost $s(V/W)F(e/m)$, and the node's row work costs $O((eK)^\tau+1)$ per unit volume, with a fixed exponent $\tau\in(0,1)$:

symbols.name: leaf depth
symbols.meaning: The recursion depth at which groups fall below $d^{1/2}$ axes.
symbols.quote: Unroll to depth $J$, where $e/m^J<d^{1/2}$.

symbols.name: level index
symbols.meaning: The recursion level of an internal node, counted from the root.
symbols.quote: An internal node at depth $j<J$ has $e/m^j\ge d^{1/2}$, so $K\le d^c\le(e/m^j)^{2c}$ and its overhead is $O((e/m^j)^\lambda)$, with fixed $\lambda<1$ and $\tau(1+2c)<\lambda$.

symbols.name: internal exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent below one bounding the internal overhead.
symbols.quote: An internal node at depth $j<J$ has $e/m^j\ge d^{1/2}$, so $K\le d^c\le(e/m^j)^{2c}$ and its overhead is $O((e/m^j)^\lambda)$, with fixed $\lambda<1$ and $\tau(1+2c)<\lambda$.

symbols.name: weight exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent with $s/W\le m^\sigma$.
symbols.quote: With $s/W\le m^\sigma$ and $0\le\sigma<\lambda$,

symbols.name: leaf size
symbols.meaning: The number of axes in a leaf group.
symbols.quote: A leaf of size $q=e/m^J$ has weight $(s/W)^J\le m^{J\sigma}=(e/q)^\sigma$, so leaves cost $O(e^\sigma q^{1-\sigma})\le O(e^\sigma d^{(1-\sigma)/2})$.

symbols.name: layer exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed cost exponent of the layer, below one.
symbols.quote: for any fixed $\lambda'$ with $\max\{\lambda,\sigma+(1-\sigma)/2\}<\lambda'<1$.

relations.quote: The tensor power $C^{\otimes D}$ is computed by [Recursive implementation of the phase network on selected bits](phase-edge-recursion.md): a group of $e$ axes splits into $m$ slots, and $s$ child calls each run on $e/m$ axes.
Intermediate values are kept exact by [Exact Gaussian dyadic arithmetic and guard widths](exact-dyadic-guard.md), using guard bits (extra integer and fractional bits).
The recursion is scheduled by [Role streams and fixed-tape depth-first scheduling](role-streams.md), so each child acts on a stream of volume $V/W$.
